name.ja: ニコラウス・オットー

overview.en: Nikolaus Otto was a German engineer who developed the first practical internal combustion engine using the four-stroke cycle that still powers most cars today.

early_life.en: Born in Holzhausen, he was self-educated and worked as a traveling salesman before becoming obsessed with building a gas-powered engine.

impact.en: The four-stroke Otto cycle engine became the basis for nearly all internal combustion engines, making possible the automobile revolution.

event.en: Founded N.A. Otto & Cie, the world's first engine manufacturing company
Built the first practical four-stroke internal combustion engine
Lost his patent after prior art by Alphonse Beau de Rochas was discovered

description.en: The first practical four-stroke internal combustion engine

text.en: The silent engine is my greatest achievement.

quotes.source: Attributed, referring to the smooth operation of the four-stroke engine
